Character triviality of rho on center and connected derived subgroup gives det(E)=O_C; Riemann–Roch chi(E((g-1)x))=0, hence H0 and H1 support coincide. Scheme-theoretic multiplicity rather than distinct-point count is necessary. The formula follows by formal intersection arithmetic, not an empirical experiment.
